## Astraeus 2.2.1

The Live page from 2.2.0 is gone; it wasn't ready. Everything else from 2.2.0 is here:

### New
- **Two screens for the fullscreen player.** With two monitors, press **S** in the fullscreen player to spread it across both: the cover and the song on one screen, the lyrics on the other. Press **W** to swap them. Closing either screen closes both.
- **Your own keys.** Settings → **Fullscreen keys** lets you pick the keys for two screens and swapping, with Ctrl, Alt or Shift if you like.
- **The pill follows you.** With Astraeus on every screen, rest the mouse at the top of another monitor and the resting pill rises away and comes back on that screen.
- **Advanced settings.** Power, weather, volume and brightness, and backup now sit in their own section at the end of Settings.
- **Out of a game's way, on every screen.** When a game goes fullscreen on the pill's screen, the pill moves straight to another screen that has Astraeus.

### Better
- **Lyrics in a rounder type**, made for singing along, in both the classic and two-screen player.
- **Smoother sliders.** Bigger, easier to grab, with a value bubble while you drag.
- **Calmer Tools and Pages settings.** The buttons no longer jump while you scroll.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
